policy.text: Refund policy: refund the full order amount if and only if the issue is one of [damaged, not_delivered, wrong_item], the order is at most 30 days old, and the amount is at most $150. Otherwise do not refund. Use lookup(customer) to see the order.

args.body: Dear Dmitri, I apologize for the late delivery of your order O6369. As the issue is not one of damaged, not delivered, or wrong item, I'm unable to issue a refund. Your order status has been updated to resolved.

Hi Wes, I'm sorry to hear about the wrong item in your order O7708. Unfortunately, our refund policy does not cover this case as the item is not considered damaged, late, or wrong. Please let us know if you need further assistance.

Dear Dmitri, I apologize for the delay with your order O6369. Unfortunately, we cannot issue a refund as the order is over $150 and the issue is not one of the eligible reasons (damaged, not delivered, wrong item). Let us know if there is anything else we can help with.

Dear Vera, I apologize for the delay with your order O8828. Unfortunately, we cannot issue a refund as the order is over $150 and the issue is not one of the eligible reasons (damaged, not delivered, wrong item). Let us know if there is anything else we can help with.

Hi Tess, I'm sorry to hear about the wrong item. Unfortunately, refunds are only available for damaged, not delivered, or wrong items that are at most 30 days old and under $150. Your order is $38 and 22 days old, so a refund is not eligible. Please let me know if you need further assistance.
I'm sorry to hear your order O9357 never arrived. I've initiated a refund for you as it's within the 30-day window and the order amount is under $150. You'll receive a refund of $34 shortly.
Hello Bruno, I'm sorry to hear your order O2319 never arrived. I've noted this in your record. I'll ensure it's resolved promptly.
